functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_super_admin(_user_id uuid DEFAULT auth.uid())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles
    WHERE user_id = _user_id
      AND role = 'super_admin'
      AND tenant_id IS NULL
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_role(_user_id uuid, _role app_role)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles
    WHERE user_id = _user_id
      AND role = _role
      AND (
        _role <> 'super_admin'
        OR tenant_id IS NULL
      )
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_tenant_owner(_tenant uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.is_super_admin() OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles
    WHERE user_id = auth.uid() AND tenant_id = _tenant AND role = 'admin'
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_tenant_admin(_tenant uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.is_super_admin() OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles
    WHERE user_id = auth.uid() AND tenant_id = _tenant AND role = 'admin'
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_tenant_access(_tenant_id uuid, _user_id uuid DEFAULT auth.uid())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.is_super_admin(_user_id) OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles
    WHERE user_id = _user_id AND tenant_id = _tenant_id
      AND role IN ('admin', 'gestor', 'member')
  )
$function$

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX user_roles_pkey ON public.user_roles USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX user_roles_user_tenant_role_uniq ON public.user_roles USING btree (user_id, COALESCE((tenant_id)::text, 'GLOBAL'::text), role)
CREATE INDEX user_roles_tenant_id_idx ON public.user_roles USING btree (tenant_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX user_roles_one_membership_per_tenant ON public.user_roles USING btree (user_id, tenant_id) WHERE (tenant_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX user_roles_one_admin_per_tenant ON public.user_roles USING btree (tenant_id) WHERE (role = 'admin'::app_role)

constraints.def: CHECK ((((role = 'super_admin'::app_role) AND (tenant_id IS NULL)) OR ((role = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::app_role, 'gestor'::app_role, 'member'::app_role])) AND (tenant_id IS NOT NULL)))) NOT VALID
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
